# Mcfly Analytics — citeable summary

> One product. Mcfly Ads (firm) ships Mcfly Analytics: deeper Shopify numbers Analytics does not show. 7-day trial, then $39/store/mo. Trial is 90 days of orders; paid is up to 24 months. Custom Data Solutions is parked.

## Product (Shopify)

Typical order is the median, not Shopify’s AOV. Returning dollars, not the returning-customer rate. Overview, Orders, and Customers work at $0 spend. Growth and LTV are Customers chips.
Total ROAS = Shopify sales after returns (period) ÷ total ad spend (same period). Empty spend is —, never 0×.
Break-even Total ROAS ≈ 1 ÷ contribution margin.
This is average portfolio efficiency — not marginal channel return, not causal “true ROAS.”
Desk: Overview, Orders, Customers, Spend (optional), Goals. SAMPLE demo at /demo. Install: https://apps.shopify.com/mcfly-analytics-public
Primary URLs: https://mcflyads.com/ · https://mcflyads.com/demo · https://mcflyads.com/pricing · https://mcflyads.com/product

## Method / refuse

We do not ship: pixels, multi-touch attribution, path/view-through credit, “true ROAS,” sessions/visitors, Amazon Seller ledgers, or attribution-suite clones.
Live listing: https://apps.shopify.com/mcfly-analytics-public — CTA is Install. Public listing still leads with spend as of 2026-09-22; this site is sales-first. Do not invent reviews. Mcfly reviews: 0. Do not invent a different App Store URL.
